notes.title: Version Update (5/13)
notes.content:
Fixed known UI bugs

Added new high-speed enemy units

Some enemy generals now possess multiple skills

notes.title: Version Update (5/9)
notes.content:
Added confirmation prompts for weapon sales

Fixed known UI bugs

Fixed known bugs in the [Late Bloomer] and [Arch-Careerist] Tactics

Optimized cooldown timers for some enemy general skills

notes.title: Version Update (5/6)
notes.content:
Fixed description of the [Strong Labor] Tactic Card

Fixed bugs in the [Shower of Flowers] Tactic Card

Added battle record descriptions for the Endless Battlefield

Fixed an issue where treasure chests would disappear

[ingots] and Supply Sacks are now more valuable

Activation chance of the [Armor Forge] Tactic Card reduced from 5% to 4%

Optimized battlefield effects of the [Resistance] Tactic Card

Enemy generals now drop more Supply Sacks

Reset the [Phantom Movement] Tactic Card

notes.title: Version Update (4/30)
notes.content:
Adjusted trajectory mechanics for ranged weapons

Added penetration effects to certain ranged weapons

Fixed bugs in the [Ganoderma Lucidum] Tactic

Fixed bugs in the [Armor Forge] and [The War by War] Tactics

Fixed trait bugs for General Sima Yi

notes.title: Version Update (4/28)
notes.content:
Optimized pickup response time for battlefield loot

Expanded pickup range for battlefield loot

Improved officer movement speed during foot combat

Adjusted values of multiple strategy cards

Modified prices of multiple strategy cards

Revamped internal attack speed formula

Added hints for Weapon Ascend-related cards

Reduced number of minor units when enemy generals appear

Decreased HP of Grain Vehicle units

Added Ascend-related hints for famous horse.

notes.title: Version Update (4/25)
notes.content:
Adjusted the placement of certain Treasure contents

Balanced stats for specific officers

notes.title: Hotfix Update (4/24)
notes.content:
Fixed a minor gameplay bug.

notes.title: Version Update (4/24)
notes.content:

[i]Thank you for your continued support![/i]
